page.overview:
Who is Slider Petrolski?

Slider Petrolski is a minor character in Cars, he is a Piston Cup racecar sponsored by Sidewall Shine and sports the number 74.

"Slider Petrolski's parents named him Slider after his uncle, famed dirt track racer Slide Powers, who graced the gritty, makeshift tracks of the late forties. Aspiring to his namesake, Slider started racing at an early age. He challenged postal trucks, taxis, delivery vans, and all varieties of unsuspecting pedestrian motorists. He even raced a police car, but only once."

Slider is one of the thirty-six race cars who compete in the Dinoco 400 at the Motor Speedway of the South. He was one of the many involved in a huge wreck caused by Chick Hicks in the early laps of the race, ramming into Floyd Mulvihill. He received some minor damage and was able to finish the race in 23rd place, coming in last.

Slider Petrolski appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Zeb. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 8th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 7th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 6th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 7th place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 8th place.
